articles.title: Oil prices ease after Trump rules out Iran attack before midterms
articles.summary: Oil prices eased slightly on Thursday after US President Donald Trump ruled out attacking Iran before next month's midterm elections, saying Washington was holding "productive discussions" with Tehran. Prices had soared earlier in the day following reports that the US could launch fresh strikes on Iran before the vote, raising fears of further supply disruptions. Republicans are fighting to keep control of both houses of Congress in the midterms, while US diesel prices are at record highs.

articles.title: White House pushes Pentagon to draft Iran strike plans ahead of midterms
articles.summary: The White House has directed the Pentagon to prepare Iran strike options that could be used before the midterms, according to The Atlantic. Officials say the push reflects Trump's desire to lower gas prices and show progress in the war before Election Day, even as critics warn a limited strike could backfire. The administration is also pursuing parallel diplomatic talks with Tehran through mediators.
